write_method_rows.claim_boundary: Scoped write() is admitted for native/prepared Vortex primitive row streams to JSON arrays/JSONL/CSV and exact provider-backed native Vortex result summaries to write_vortex/JSONL/CSV. write_json is admitted only when a JSON array is derived from a native/prepared Vortex primitive row stream or ordinary SQL/generated scalar/grouped aggregate result rows with explicit decode/materialization evidence. It must not execute direct decoded local-source sink code as the public runtime middle.

write_jsonl is admitted only when JSONL output is derived from a native/prepared Vortex primitive row stream, scalar/grouped aggregate result rows, or exact provider-backed native Vortex result summary with explicit decode/materialization evidence. It must not execute direct decoded local-source sink code as the public runtime middle.

fanout is admitted for JSONL/CSV outputs when every declared output is derived from the same native/prepared Vortex primitive row stream or exact provider-backed native Vortex result summary and local multi-target writes use staged commit with partial-write cleanup evidence.
